browser_runtime_test.reason: Headless Chromium navigation to localhost is blocked by the execution environment policy (chrome-error://chromewebdata/). Static/runtime syntax checks completed; final interaction test must be executed in a normal browser after deployment.

known_boundaries: Connected services remain network-dependent unless they have a local snapshot.
External basemap tiles are not included in the required expedition package; local scientific layers remain available through the application mapping engine/fallback.
Storage quotas and persistence decisions are controlled by the browser/OS; the interface now reports them but cannot guarantee a fixed quota.
Background synchronization to a central server is intentionally not implemented because ITA ARANDU remains local-first and has no mandatory remote data store.
